audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side is flatlined to 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already correctly has Tristana winning all 7 stages.
audit.why: Seraphine has a slow telegraphed Q, low base HP, and a flat-damage enchanter kit with no dash — Tristana's range, E burst, and W reset dominate every stage per the content whys, not a coinflip.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-6].side to Tristana to match the already-correct content win[] (no win[] edit needed), and rewrote each why to state the real, grounded reason instead of the generic jump-bomb-R template.

audit.why: Content spikes already correctly mark level 3-5 (E-then-W burst on her low HP), level 6 (R as escape/finisher vs her utility R), first item (reset DPS vs her flat damage), and late (kite Encore, spread the fight) as the swings.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags two things not yet in the text: Grievous Wounds timing against her W sustain, and her Stage Presence auto-reset triple-cast tell.
audit.why: Surround Sound (W) heals nearby allies once she's already shielded, so anti-heal timing matters in extended trades; Stage Presence casts every third spell twice, and the wind-up before that spell is a readable tell to disengage on.
audit.corrected: Named an anti-heal item in itemization and added the triple-cast tell to breakdown.cooldowns.
